notes: Route 1 is one chain through al-Zuhri and Salim; the story of Ibn Umar and Salim is its matn, not a new isnad

Routes 2 to 4 come after the saying («وحدثنيه») and each runs to al-Zuhri («كلهم عن الزهري»), then «بهذا الإسناد» as a back_reference: written in full in each group, since route 1 does not share their tail
«أو أبو لبابة» and «ونرى ذلك من سميهما» are inside the story or a remark, not links; «غير أن صالحا» and «في حديث يونس» are wording variants, left out
«أبي» in route 4 is the father of يعقوب: a bare relation
